Private Function Dumped(ws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim c As Range, s As String
    For Each c In ws.UsedRange.Cells
        If Not IsEmpty(c.Value) Then s = s & c.Address(False, False) & "=" & TypeName(c.Value) & ":" & c.Text & ";"
    Next
    Dumped = s
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, s As String, v As String, r As Variant
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\saved.xlsx")
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Act which, folder, ws, r
    s = "ok "
Answered:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = "": v = CStr(r)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v & "|" & Dumped(ws)
    Dim other As Workbook
    If Workbooks.Count > 1 Then
        For Each other In Workbooks
            If Not other Is ThisWorkbook And Not other Is wb Then other.SaveCopyAs folder & "\o" & which & ".xlsx": other.Close False: Exit For
        Next
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    wb.SaveCopyAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx"
    wb.Close False
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = s
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " "
    Resume Answered
End Function
